protocol:
1. Prepare the bench with turquoise and green tube racks, clear snap-cap microtubes/PCR tubes, a connected PCR tube strip, an adjustable yellow-plunger micropipette, disposable 200 µL pipette tips in a purple tip box, and waste containers.

2. Label clear snap-cap reaction tubes in the turquoise rack using a permanent marker; two source tubes in the green rack are labeled “H2O” and “S”.

3. Fit the adjustable micropipette with a disposable tip and transfer clear liquid between an open microcentrifuge tube and the labeled reaction tubes in the turquoise rack; no pipette volume setting is visible.

4. Use the same adjustable micropipette with disposable tips to add clear liquid from an open microcentrifuge tube into a labeled tube held by hand, keeping the snap cap open during dispensing.

5. Place the prepared labeled reaction tube back into the turquoise rack.

6. Hold a connected strip of clear PCR tubes with caps open and dispense clear liquid sequentially into multiple tubes of the strip using the adjustable micropipette; no volume setting is visible.

7. Continue dispensing clear liquid into the remaining open PCR strip tubes, moving the pipette tip from tube to tube across the strip.

8. Return the filled PCR tube strip to the turquoise rack.
